title: Buy 1-Year Access All Areas Membership for $75, Get 1 Membership Free + $30 Visa Gift Card @ Entertainment Book
body:
Deal: Buy 1-Year Access All Areas Membership for $75, Get 1 Membership Free + $30 Visa Gift Card @ Entertainment Book

[frogduck] Assuming this thing is across Australia, sure :)
[hashtagbargain] Wow the entertainment book has lost its appeal. None of the restaurants we used to use this at near me are on it anymore. Shows why it is so devalued like this.
[arcticmonkey] They don't seem to be doing any business development to add venues, near me at least.
[Spun] PSA: this is also included with the NRMA roadside assistance plan, accessible through the NRMA app.
